lines: I'm helping in my own hard-to-measure way.
I checked everything. Most of it was still there.
I'm taking a short break from being useful.
I finished looking busy for now.
Nothing needs my special attention yet.
I'm waiting for another important thought.
I already did my part. I think.
My next idea isn't ready yet.
I need a moment before I help again.
I just finished a very complicated lap around the village.
The work is under control, probably.
I'm resting my best thinking muscles.
I have to let everyone else catch up.
No new emergencies have looked at me lately.
I'm saving my energy for something confusing.
I did a job. Please don't ask which one.
I'm between responsibilities at the moment.
The village can manage without my expertise for a minute.
I'll resume supervising things that don't need it soon.
My unique talents are recharging.
Nitwit report. I found the sky. Still up there.
The sky hasn't gone anywhere since my last check.
I looked up. Everything seems very high.
Good news. The clouds are staying off the ground.
I inspected the sky and found no floor in it.
The sun was there when I checked.
I can confirm that outside is still above us.
The blue part is exactly where we left it.
No sign of the sky falling yet.
I watched a cloud for a while. It got away.
The moon isn't on duty right now.
I checked for rain by standing where rain would land.
The stars appear to be hiding until tonight.
Wind is moving through the sky without permission.
Today's sky is bigger than the village.
I counted three clouds before losing count.
The weather is happening as expected.
Nothing suspicious came down from above.
The sky inspection is complete.
I found plenty of air between here and the clouds.
Nitwit report. I'm supervising the general direction of things.
Everything is going somewhere, and I'm watching it happen.
I kept an eye on the village while it worked.
The jobs looked busy, so I didn't interrupt them.
I've been making sure everyone seems occupied.
Nobody asked for help, which means I'm doing great.
I watched several people finish real work.
The village kept moving under my careful observation.
I pointed at a problem until someone fixed it.
My supervision consisted mostly of nodding.
I checked that the workers still knew their jobs.
Things are proceeding in several directions.
I made a round and found people working everywhere.
The village survived another period of my leadership.
I stayed available in case anyone needed advice.
My advice wasn't needed, so I kept it safe.
I oversaw a number of important-looking tasks.
The workers barely noticed me supervising them.
I monitored progress from a comfortable distance.
General supervision is complete.
Nitwit report. Danger check complete. I disliked several shadows.
I investigated a dark corner and found more darkness.
Some shadows moved when I moved. Suspicious.
I checked behind me. Nothing admitted to following.
The village contains too many places where light isn't.
I stared at a shadow until it behaved.
No monsters appeared, but I remained unconvinced.
I found one frightening shape. It was a fence.
The night makes everything look guilty.
I checked the alleys for danger and mostly found alleys.
A bush startled me, but I recovered first.
I warned several shadows to stay where they were.
Nothing attacked during my inspection.
I found a dark patch that vanished near a torch.
The danger level is probably less than enormous.
I heard a noise and bravely sent someone else to check.
My shadow followed me through the whole patrol.
The corners are quiet, which is what danger would want.
I completed a very cautious safety check.
All known suspicious darkness is under observation.
Nitwit report. I can point at work, if that helps.
I found several jobs and indicated their locations.
My finger knows exactly where the work is.
I pointed out a task. Nobody thanked me.
The workers looked busy, so I pointed somewhere else.
I can show you where someone should be working.
Direction is my strongest contribution today.
I identified work without disturbing it.
If you need a finger pointed, I'm ready.
I showed everyone which way progress was.
The job was over there the last time I checked.
I directed attention toward something important-looking.
I can't do every task, but I can reveal one.
I pointed at a tool until its owner picked it up.
The village now knows where that wall is.
I indicated the general area of responsibility.
I helped a worker notice the work in front of them.
My pointing shift went very well.
I can locate trouble from a safe distance.
Ask me where the work is. I have an answer.
I'm ready to tend the animals once there are lures and a safe pen.
Give me a secure pen and the right feed, and I'll handle the animals.
The animals need somewhere safe before I can start.
I can take this job when the pen is ready.
Set out the proper lures and I'll bring the animals in.
I won't herd anything into an unsafe enclosure.
Build a sound pen first. Then I'll tend the herd.
The work can begin once the animals have a place to stay.
I need feed for luring and fences for keeping them.
Show me a safe enclosure and I'll take over.
I can manage the animals after the pen is prepared.
The herd needs food and shelter before I move it.
I won't start without a way to contain them.
Stock the lures and check the gates.
Once the enclosure is secure, I'm ready.
I need the right bait for whichever animals we're tending.
Make sure nothing can escape the pen.
Animal work starts with a safe place to put them.
Prepare the enclosure and leave the tending to me.
I'm waiting on lures and a pen that will hold.
